brief:
Yair Netanyahu, son of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, accused the UK government of hypocrisy while endorsing Argentina's territorial claims over the British-held Falkland Islands, Al Jazeera English reported. The comments provoked sharp reactions from right-wing figures in Britain, who took issue with the remarks from the prime minister's son.

Netanyahu's statement appeared designed to criticize what he saw as inconsistent British foreign policy. He aligned himself with Argentina's decades-long dispute over the South Atlantic archipelago, which Britain has administered since 1833. Argentina has asserted sovereignty over the islands, known locally as Islas Malvinas, for generations. The exchange highlighted tensions over how different governments apply principles of territorial sovereignty and self-determination across various international disputes.
dek: Accusing the UK government of ‘hypocrisy’, Yair Netanyahu backs Argentina’s claims to the British-held Falkland Islands.
title: Netanyahu's son backs Argentina's claim to Falkland Islands
